summary: Locus standi of third party to challenge quashment of FIR based on compromise; seriousness of POCSO and SC/ST Act offences; offences against society, not private; quashment under Section 482 Cr.P.C. impermissible for heinous crimes; Gian Singh distinguishable; public interest override; victim's trauma acknowledged; State's inaction criticized.
legal_provisions_cited: SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(r), s.3(1)(s), s.3(1)(b), s.3(2)(vii)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned quashment order set aside; criminal proceedings restored; matter remanded for trial.
